title: Emrys and the Clock
author: Coral Montrose
blurb: Mirabel Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
